objective: Select and explain a quality-non-inferior architecture that improves measured training and serving cost across sequence, depth, and width.

primary_conventional.description: PreNorm dense Transformer with global GQA, standard residuals, dense SwiGLU, and the same tokenizer, data, optimizer policy, and active parameter target.
primary_conventional.reason: Anchors the claim against a conventional architecture rather than only against earlier Speck variants.

primary_hybrid.description: Current conservative KDA/sigmoid/NoPE model with five independently refreshed global GQA memories, standard residuals, and dense SwiGLU.
primary_hybrid.reason: Separates new depth, width, and attention-compression effects from the established Speck long-context control.
